title: Thingiverse - Pattes de couvercle de filtre a pollen 993
notes: La fiche Thingiverse identifie le modele 2152823 de LimeyBoy, destine aux pattes des deux couvercles de filtre a pollen d'une 993. Deux variantes sont decrites dans les index publics : remplacement d'une patte manquante et renfort par-dessus une patte existante ou recolle. Une fiche d'archive secondaire annonce une bbox d'environ 30,700 x 18 x 10,800 mm, sans protocole ni verification independante. La page primaire moderne ne restitue pas automatiquement les fichiers ni la licence; ne rien telecharger, redistribuer ou integrer avant verification directe des fichiers, de l'auteur, des unites et des droits. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-RENN3D-POLLEN-FILTER-COVER-TABS, whose secondary archive declares CC-BY without a version; the licence string here now records that declaration. On 2026-10-15 the original Thingiverse page (thing 2152823) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. Before this pass the access fields recorded a browser page read on 2026-08-29. The Internet Archive index lists captures dated 2024-05-27 and 2024-12-09 (HTTP 200); they were not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. Rights remain unknown in both records. The evidence level (C here, D in the twin) is not reconciled by this pass. 2026-11-07: the live primary Thingiverse page was read in an ordinary browser without login or challenge bypass; the explicit Creative Commons link confirms CC-BY-4.0. See docs/research/thingiverse-primary-licences-20261107.md for the exact asset, author, file list and limits. This supersedes the earlier access/licence conclusion, while preserving the historical notes. No model file was downloaded or imported; dimensions, units and fitment remain independently unverified. Secondary-page access dates are unchanged because those pages were not reread.
